name: Claude Code
notes: Plugins installed here reach the Claude Code CLI and the desktop app's Code tab; Cowork has its own plugin store (see the claude-desktop adapter). The GUI process gets a minimal PATH on both platforms, so every install channel is probed directly: the native installer's ~/.local/bin (claude on macOS/Linux, claude.exe on Windows), Homebrew's bin dirs, npm shims (npm.cmd dir, nvm/volta/pnpm/asdf), and the copy bundled inside Claude Desktop. The newest version among the candidates wins.
